methodology.stage: development benchmark; no untouched final-test claim
methodology.forest: 200 trees; random_state=0; 1% normal calibration quantile; fixed sigmoid scores; early 80% normal time fit and later 20% calibration, with crossing windows discarded; per_capture applies this split separately to every recording
methodology.comparison: Both detectors score identical extracted evaluation features; forest includes jitter-collapse count
methodology.normal_scope: HCRL: [0,120) baseline and [121,241) holdout from same recording. ROAD: baseline recordings wholly excluded from normal evaluation. Broad profile uses 120 s of each of five varied normal recordings, evaluates remaining seven ambient prefixes.
methodology.labels: HCRL supplied frame labels; ROAD interval/ID-derived labels, whole-interval fuzzing
methodology.limitations: Overlapping windows, HCRL shared normal source, related ROAD fabrication/masquerade pairs, prior development on these datasets, and one partially observed tail window per capture. False-positive improvements do not establish transfer to unseen vehicles.
